text:
Rina: quick post-all-hands note re: travel/offsite ops 	6 compiling a short Q list for managers and hosts.

Tom: go ahead, dropping notes here.

Rina: 1) RSVP cutoff for offsites? all-hands mentioned 2 weeks but some teams need 10 business days. want a single rule managers can cite.

Kate: official rule: 10 business days for vendor-attended headcounts; 14 calendar days if you need a hotel block. small internal gatherings can use the short-lead exception. snippet: 

```
RSVP deadlines:
- Vendor-attended offsite: RSVP by 10 business days prior.
- Hotel block required: confirm 14 calendar days prior.
- Short-lead internal (<25 ppl, no vendors): 4 weeks NOT required, use short-lead form.
- Late adds: possible but team covers incremental costs.
```

Tom: vendor deposits question  who signs off on non-refundable deposits >$1k? some vendors insist on 50% deposit.

Kate: deposit matrix: Manager approves <$1k; People Ops + Manager for $1k-$5k; >$5k requires Director sign-off. new vendors require vendor-risk intake form attached to the request.

Rina: childcare / family support came up during Q&A  any stance on paying for on-site childcare or stipend?

peopleops-bot: People Ops pilot: childcare stipend up to $150/day for primary caregivers attending company-mandated offsites; pre-approval required via the People Ops form. On-site childcare must meet safety checklist; accessibility and reasonable accommodations are fully company-covered. Draft policy uploaded to intranet.

Tom: facilities note: rotating "team block" reservations at hubs  is that happening? some teams want to reserve a row for a few days during an intense sprint week.

facilities-bot: Pilot live: team-block reservations allowed for up to 5 consecutive days with prior approval. Booking window remains 14-day rolling for hot desks; assigned desks separate. To request a team block, email facilities@redwood with dates, headcount, and justification.

Kate: also clarifying mixed itineraries (customer + conference): we treat combined estimated cost against approval thresholds; if customer co-pays, annotate the split and attach any PO.

Rina: great. final ask: can People Ops publish a 1-page manager cheat-sheet that covers RSVP rules, deposit thresholds, childcare pilot, team-block process, and short-lead exception? managers need something concise to share in team meetings.

peopleops-bot: Draft manager cheat-sheet uploaded: https://intranet.redwood/ops/manager-cheatsheet-offsites-2026 (auto). ETA for final: Thurs EOD.

Tom: I'll post the summary to the managers channel and flag teams that need the short-lead exception. thanks everyone.

Rina: closing loop. TL;DR: RSVP & hotel cutoff clarified, deposit approval matrix, childcare pilot announced, team-block pilot for hubs. :white_check_mark:
